findings.text: non-blocking: methods names the reference as `total`, so row["gradient_relative"]["reference"] (report.py:270), row["hessian_relative"]["reference"] (report.py:273) and row["plasma_gradient_relative"]["reference"] (report.py:286) subtract the reference from itself and are identically 0.0 in receipt.json and in the manifest's evidence_inputs; a reader sees a measured zero reference error where no measurement was taken

non-blocking: coil_reference returns the cached coil-stencils.npz as soon as the file exists, with no digest, revision or input binding checked, so a rerun after any change to the points, the coils or the reference helper silently reuses the earlier stencils and the coil positive control then validates stale numbers

non-blocking: the per-batch coil-direct-<first>.npz cache is read back on existence alone (report.py:108), the same unbound-cache hazard as the coil stencil cache, and here it also hides a partial batch if a run died between batches

non-blocking: the same three-step central-difference Richardson extrapolation is written out five times inside this node, at measure.py:55, report.py:124, cell.py:167, projected.py:87 and terms.py:68; no repository owner for it exists so this is not a fork of an existing capability, but one helper in the node would remove four transcription sites the diagnosis depends on being identical
